rookery_unified.folder_label: Batch Review — Male Anhinga in Rookery Habitat
rookery_unified.subject: Male Anhinga in a dense wetland rookery, with egrets/spoonbill as environmental context.
rookery_unified.overall_verdict: Strong behavioral/location set with two visual modes: rookery chaos (nest-side, wing display) and cleaner willow portrait. Strongest frames are where eye, crest, white wing pattern, and rookery context read clearly — not always the technically cleanest frames.
rookery_unified.carousel_hook: A quiet Anhinga portrait… until the rookery drama begins.
rookery_unified.left_out_summary: DSC_0768 too close to DSC_0772 (0772 cleaner). DSC_0800/0801/0804 redundant vs DSC_0802. DSC_0699/0700/0702 redundant with DSC_0698.

DSC_0808.strengths: Strong behavioral moment: wings open, clear Anhinga shape, nice rookery context. Good environmental storytelling with egrets/spoonbill/nest on the right.
DSC_0808.critique: Focus/Exposure: Usable, but head partly hidden and dark body loses detail. Composition: Bird slightly swallowed by branches; right side busy but informative. Story/Mood: Strong arrival at the rookery feeling.
DSC_0808.improvements: Crop slightly tighter from left and top. Lift shadows on black body locally; protect white wing bands.
DSC_0808.verdict: Strong behavioral opener for the rookery sequence.

DSC_0698.strengths: Best upright alert pose from the rookery branch sequence. Eye ring and bill clear; background egrets add depth.
DSC_0698.critique: Focus/Exposure: Good on head/upper body; background whites bright but not disastrous. Composition: Very busy, but vertical Anhinga silhouette holds attention. Story/Mood: Watchful, tense, observational.
DSC_0698.improvements: Radial mask on head/eye: +0.20 to +0.35 EV, a little texture. Darken bright background egret slightly.
DSC_0698.verdict: Best upright alert rookery pose — Top keep; carousel slide 2.

DSC_0699.critique: Very similar to DSC_0698, slightly less distinct. Pose and composition almost duplicated.
DSC_0699.verdict: Reject in favor of DSC_0698 or DSC_0700.

DSC_0700.strengths: Background egret movement adds life. Anhinga pose stable and readable.
DSC_0700.critique: Focus/Exposure: Subject acceptable; white egret is secondary attention magnet. Composition: Centered in crowded frame. Story/Mood: Busy colony more than portrait.
DSC_0700.improvements: Reduce highlights on background egret. Crop a little from the left.

DSC_0702.critique: Less engaging head angle; moment feels static.

DSC_0703.strengths: Direct back-facing symmetry; graphic feather pattern on back.
DSC_0703.critique: No eye contact; too much branch clutter for rear-view. Story/Mood: Pause between better moments.
DSC_0703.improvements: Not a primary select; transitional frame only.
DSC_0703.verdict: Not primary — keep only if need transitional frame.

DSC_0704.strengths: Excellent behavioral moment: looking down toward nest/gray bird area. Blue eye ring visible.
DSC_0704.critique: Focus/Exposure: Head/eye usable; black neck could open. Composition: Downward head curve elegant; right-side rookery clutter heavy. Story/Mood: Inspection / nesting attention.
DSC_0704.improvements: Local mask on head/eye: Exposure +0.25, Texture +10, Clarity +5. Desaturate background greens/yellows.
DSC_0704.verdict: Best rookery behavioral storytelling — Top keep; carousel slide 3.

DSC_0705.strengths: More side profile than 0704; good body shape and wing pattern.
DSC_0705.critique: Head less strong than 0704; lacks looking-down tension. Story/Mood: Observational, quieter.
DSC_0705.improvements: Crop right to reduce nest clutter. Alternate if prefer body profile over behavior.

DSC_0707.critique: Close to DSC_0708 but weaker; background egret interesting but head less clean.

DSC_0708.strengths: Strongest looking-back pose from branch group. Crest, blue eye ring, shoulder pattern read well.
DSC_0708.critique: Focus/Exposure: Good subject detail; background whites need highlight control. Composition: Nicely framed by branches, still busy. Story/Mood: Alert, dramatic, good personality.
DSC_0708.improvements: Burn background egret -0.3 to -0.5 EV. Small eye mask on blue orbital skin.
DSC_0708.verdict: Good personality / look-back frame — Top keep.

DSC_0758.strengths: Softer willow habitat; bird embedded in foliage.
DSC_0758.critique: Not crispest of willow set; bird small, some clutter. Story/Mood: Quiet transition from rookery chaos.
DSC_0758.improvements: Crop tighter keeping willow canopy. Selective contrast on bird; soft foliage.

DSC_0766.strengths: Better side profile than 0758; bill, eye, body shape readable.
DSC_0766.critique: Fine feather detail softened by distance/foliage. Composition: Trunk and willow frame bird well. Story/Mood: Calm portrait with habitat.
DSC_0766.improvements: Crop from left to reduce trunk dominance. Mild edge vignette.

DSC_0768.strengths: Cleaner willow portrait; nice profile, body line, background separation.
DSC_0768.critique: Focus/Exposure: Good on subject; controlled whites/greens. Composition: Natural curved branches. Story/Mood: Elegant and calm.
DSC_0768.improvements: Slightly lift eye/head. Consider 4:5 crop, bird right-center third.
DSC_0768.verdict: Strong alternate clean willow portrait — Top keep (function overlaps 0772).

DSC_0772.strengths: Strongest clean side-profile in willow set. Excellent bill line and alert head angle.
DSC_0772.critique: Focus/Exposure: Good clarity; blacks hold detail. Composition: Busy but cohesive foliage. Story/Mood: Calm, watchful, refined.
DSC_0772.improvements: Keep processing restrained. Reduce green saturation/luminance for pattern authority.
DSC_0772.verdict: Best clean portrait / technical keeper — Top keep; carousel slide 1.

DSC_0774.critique: Similar to DSC_0772 but bill overlaps foliage; head/eye less clean.

DSC_0787.strengths: Good profile; strong eye/bill visibility; nice diagonal perch.
DSC_0787.critique: Bird a little recessed behind willow; head boxed by foliage. Story/Mood: Pleasant but less decisive than 0772.
DSC_0787.improvements: Crop tighter from left/top. Small radial mask on face.

DSC_0800.strengths: Strong wing-display action; white wing bands graphic.
DSC_0800.critique: Head partly hidden; branches interfere; faces away. Story/Mood: Excellent behavioral energy.
DSC_0800.improvements: Use for action over portrait. Pull down highlights on white birds at right.

DSC_0801.critique: Close to 0800/0802; wing spread good but head not clean.

DSC_0802.strengths: Best wing-spread frame. Symmetrical, dramatic; white wing bands very strong.
DSC_0802.critique: Head mostly hidden limits emotional connection. Composition: Busy but wing shape overpowers clutter. Story/Mood: Peak behavior — action payoff.
DSC_0802.improvements: Include in story carousel. Crop tighter left/top; reduce right-side brightness.
DSC_0802.verdict: Best action / wing-display — Top keep; carousel slide 4.

DSC_0804.strengths: Excellent wing-display; slightly different wing position from 0802.
DSC_0804.critique: Head obscured; white bird on right edge distracting. Story/Mood: Strong but less clean than 0802.
DSC_0804.improvements: Reject unless this wing position is favorite. Crop or darken right edge.
